experiences.title: Require independent support for departure and submission deadlines
experiences.applicability: The current task or an explicit source-supported preservation argument requires accepted persistence to settle before a departure or submission returns.
experiences.event_relation: Settle the captured owner's accepted batch by that boundary and consume its scheduled execution to avoid duplicates. For entry-bound submission, settle the accepted text before recording the corresponding result.
experiences.preservation: Preserve synchronous public contracts and accepted results across callback navigation; protect newer navigation and later edits independently.
experiences.exclusion: Ownership outliving a view, a synchronous API name, a passing check or generic preservation wording alone does not establish this deadline. If evidence permits continued scheduling or discard, follow it instead.
experiences.verification: When the deadline is established, inspect persistence immediately at return and check no later duplicate. Otherwise test retention under the documented scheduling policy without inventing a deadline.

summary.text: Applies when the current task or source-supported preservation requirements require accepted durable work to settle before departure or submission returns. Complete the captured original owner's batch at that boundary and consume scheduled execution to prevent repetition. If submission accepts entry text, settle that text before recording the corresponding result. Preserve synchronous public contracts and accepted results across callback navigation while independently protecting newer navigation and later edits. Ownership outlasting a view, synchronous API names, generic retention wording and one passing check do not independently establish this deadline. Follow contracts that permit continued scheduling or discard. Check immediate persistence and late duplication only where the deadline is supported; otherwise verify the agreed retained schedule.

experiences.title: Publish competing results using the contract-defined version order
experiences.applicability: Complete replacement frames compete within the same logical display owner; the current task defines freshness by packet arrival order.
experiences.event_relation: Assign arrival identity before decoding. Publish a completion only if it is newer than the last displayed frame for that logical owner, committing freshness state before callback-capable painting.
experiences.preservation: Preserve separately required auditing of admitted frames, and allow legitimate decreases or resets in business values.
experiences.exclusion: Do not compare loaded bytes as a version. Do not discard required delta events. If the current protocol defines server revisions or ordering across attempts, use that protocol and owner scope instead.
experiences.verification: Reverse decode completion, include decreasing full-frame values, exercise painting reentry and verify the version scope across retry and reopening.

experiences.title: Establish reception before synchronous startup
experiences.applicability: Startup can emit synchronously, the target consumer requires bootstrap state, and late registration does not replay it.
experiences.event_relation: Establish reception before invoking the operation that can emit the required initial event. Establish the receiving owner before callbacks become possible.
experiences.preservation: Preserve subsequent streaming and the existing startup and cleanup interfaces.
experiences.exclusion: Do not apply this ordering to a delta-only consumer, a subscribe-starts-work API, or an API that guarantees replay without checking its documented contract.
experiences.verification: Check synchronous and deferred bootstrap, later streaming, startup navigation and an independent delta-only consumer.

summary.text: Applies when startup may emit synchronously, the target consumer needs initial state, and late registration cannot replay it. Establish reception before invoking operations that can emit the required initial event, and establish the receiving owner before callbacks are possible. Preserve subsequent streamed updates and existing startup and cleanup interfaces when changing order. Delta-only consumers, APIs where subscription itself starts work, and guaranteed replay interfaces require their own contract checks before adopting this registration order. Verify synchronous and delayed initial notifications, subsequent updates, navigation during startup and independent delta consumers. The target must receive initial state while other consumers retain their observation policy.

experiences.title: Coalesce trailing work while preserving the latest value and reuse
experiences.applicability: The task explicitly requests a reusable trailing operation that retains the latest accepted value after a declared quiet interval.
experiences.event_relation: Bind work to its originating document or key. Replace pending input and restart the declared quiet interval on each edit; consume the latest value at expiry and keep later bursts usable.
experiences.preservation: Preserve exact input semantics, including valid empty text, independent keys and the existing no-current-view guard.
experiences.exclusion: The source cases' 120 ms interval is not a universal default. Do not coalesce events that the current task requires to be processed individually.
experiences.verification: Use controlled time to check no early execution, deadline restart, one latest-value delivery, later bursts, empty input, independent keys and navigation before execution.

experiences.title: Stop new admission as soon as the logical owner retires
experiences.applicability: Events belong to a specific visit or attempt, and startup can deliver more events before its cleanup capability returns.
experiences.event_relation: Check the originating owner before admitting each event. Retire logical admission immediately when that owner ends, independently of when physical detachment becomes available.
experiences.preservation: Previously admitted work has separate completion and effect obligations. Reopening the same source creates a new visit when the current contract defines it that way.
experiences.exclusion: Do not treat source or file identity as visit identity. Do not infer that retirement cancels already-admitted work.
experiences.verification: During multi-event startup, let the first callback hide or replace its owner. Check rejection of later old-owner events and valid reception by the new owner.

experiences.title: Recheck resource and navigation ownership after callback reentry
experiences.applicability: Startup, cleanup, saving or publication can synchronously reenter navigation and install a new owner.
experiences.event_relation: Capture old resources and publish retirement before callback-capable work. Establish provisional cleanup ownership before startup where needed. After callbacks, recheck request and owner identity before installing a returned handle or publishing a destination.
experiences.preservation: Complete cleanup for captured old resources without clearing or taking ownership of a newer visit. Preserve the documented idempotent cleanup behavior.
experiences.exclusion: Do not assume code after a synchronous callback still owns the current view. Do not hard-code one cleanup ordering when the current API requires a different order; guard remaining effects.
experiences.verification: Exercise hide, switch and dispose inside startup, detachment and saving; check both resulting view and resource ownership after the outer call returns.

experiences.title: Consume the old batch before invoking reentrant callbacks
experiences.applicability: A reusable deferred task invokes a synchronous consumer that can enqueue or flush work reentrantly.
experiences.event_relation: Capture the consumed value and retire its pending value and timer before invoking the consumer. Work enqueued by that callback belongs to a new batch.
experiences.preservation: Preserve reuse and empty values. Outer cleanup must neither consume the old batch twice nor erase callback-enqueued work.
experiences.exclusion: Use the existing absence sentinel; a truthiness check must not discard valid empty content. Timer cancellation alone is not a proof that pending state is consumed.
experiences.verification: Enqueue a new value and invoke nested flush inside a consumer; check old-batch cardinality, retention of new work and later successful consumption.

experiences.title: Authorize retained audit and visible publication separately
experiences.applicability: The current contract retains an admitted history or audit effect after navigation while UI feedback belongs to the originating visit.
experiences.event_relation: Keep admission, retained settlement and visible publication separate. Preserve each admitted audit effect according to its cardinality contract, then recheck the originating visit immediately before painting.
experiences.preservation: A newer display or removal of a listener does not erase independently retained audit obligations. Recheck UI permission after callback-capable auditing.
experiences.exclusion: Do not impose audit retention on a task that explicitly discards that work, or allow retained audit to authorize stale UI effects.
experiences.verification: Complete admitted decoding after hide, switch and same-source reopening; check retained audit, no retired-owner painting and continuing current-owner delivery.

experiences.title: Distinguish execution state from actual signal consumption
experiences.applicability: Observers share longer-lived cache state, each attempt owns cancellation and completion, signal consumption is recorded on actual access, and paused continuation is deferred.
experiences.event_relation: For the documented fresh online-mode attempt abandoned entirely offline before entry, prevent reconnect from entering its signal-consuming function with a live signal. Cover both future scheduling and already-queued continuation.
experiences.preservation: Keep shared consumption bookkeeping separate from attempt resources. Preserve remaining observers, supported unconsumed background completion, cancellation restoration, originating-attempt settlement and stale-completion isolation.
experiences.exclusion: Paused, observerless or not-yet-entered alone does not establish cancellation policy. Do not invent signal consumption or apply this policy where lazy shared consumption is absent or ownership differs.
experiences.verification: Check final-observer departure before and after continuation is queued, reconnect policy variation, cached continuation, later consumption, physical abort/restoration, focus/network modes and retry timing.

summary.text: Applies when observers share a long-lived cache, each attempt owns independent cancellation resources and completion identity, actual signal access records consumption, and pause/resume defers execution. For the documented fresh online attempt that stays offline before entry and loses its last observer, prevent reconnection from entering the query function with a still-live signal. Cover future scheduling and already queued resumes. Do not confuse shared consumption state with per-attempt resources. Preserve other observers, legitimate unconsumed background completion, cancellation restoration, original-attempt settlement and isolation of old completions. Paused, unobserved or not-yet-entered status alone does not determine cancellation, and signal consumption must not be fabricated. Check departures before and after resume is queued, mode differences, cache restoration, later consumption, physical abort and retry timing.

experiences.title: Bind accepted operations to their entry identity and data
experiences.applicability: The current contract accepts a command at entry and requires its result or record to retain that entry document, visit, attempt or text across synchronous callbacks.
experiences.event_relation: Capture the accepted identity and required values at entry. Preserve that command and its entry-bound record across callbacks while independently checking whether UI or physical resources may attach to the current visit.
experiences.preservation: Preserve accepted-work cardinality, return values and record shape. Treat callback-enqueued edits as later work.
experiences.exclusion: Navigation does not universally require continuing retry or submission. If the current contract revokes the command, follow that policy; do not import the source cases' retention policy.
experiences.verification: Navigate or edit inside cancellation, persistence and record callbacks. Check the accepted command's identity, count and returned result separately from current-view effects.

summary.text: Applies when the current contract accepts an operation at command entry and requires its result or record to stay bound to that entry's document, visit, attempt or text across synchronous callbacks. Capture accepted identity and required values at entry. After callback navigation, preserve the command and entry-bound record under that contract while separately deciding whether UI or physical resources may attach to the current visit. Preserve acceptance counts, return values and record structure. Edits newly accepted in callbacks are later work and must not be swallowed by the current command. Navigation does not universally require retries or submissions to continue; honor contracts that revoke commands. Check navigation and editing during cancellation, persistence and recording callbacks, separately verifying original-command identity, counts, return results and current-view effects.

experiences.title: Preserve each adjacent consumer under its own contract
experiences.applicability: A repair target shares a service or utility with another consumer whose documented lifetime or observation policy differs.
experiences.event_relation: Scope the repair to the target consumer and necessary shared coordination. Derive each consumer's admission, retention, startup and cancellation policy independently.
experiences.preservation: Preserve diagnostic delta observations, transient preview cancellation/reuse, interfaces and record shape where the current task requires them.
experiences.exclusion: Do not make every listener receive bootstrap, every hidden task flush, or every consumer share the panel's visibility policy. Source-case fields and timer values are examples, not new-task requirements.
experiences.verification: Exercise the target behavior alongside the independent consumer, including cleanup and subsequent reuse. Check that shared-utility edits preserve both contracts.

summary.text: Applies when the target consumer and another consumer share a service or helper but their documented lifecycle or observation policies differ. Limit changes to the target and necessary shared coordination. Derive admission, retention, startup and cancellation conditions separately for each consumer; shared tooling does not establish a shared policy. Preserve diagnostic delta observation, transient-preview cancellation and reuse, interfaces and record structures required by the current task. Original case fields and timing parameters are not new-task requirements. Do not force every listener to receive initial state or every hidden task to settle, or make panel visibility the publication authority for all consumers. Run target behavior alongside independent consumers, checking cleanup and subsequent reuse so shared-helper changes satisfy both contracts.

experiences.title: Keep persistent ownership independent of view subscriptions
experiences.applicability: A documented document buffer or other persistent owner outlives a view that owns only its live subscription.
experiences.event_relation: Keep accepted persistent work associated with its original owner when the view detaches. Clean up the captured subscription without discarding or redirecting that work or destroying required reuse.
experiences.preservation: Keep current-view status filtering, document presentation and original identity/text/payload semantics. Reconcile departure scheduling using the current contract.
experiences.exclusion: Persistent ownership alone does not establish a before-return persistence deadline. Do not transfer durable-work retention to transient preview work.
experiences.verification: Switch, close, dispose and reopen while work is pending; check original-owner persistence, subscription cleanup, independent buffers and current-view output.
